content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"no","applies_why":"No: the judge text does not count any verse as an unanswered witness and instead says the matter was answered.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.","rule_words":"A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.","room":"none","why":"Because the judge identifies the matter as answered in [CR2] and [CR3], K-G4 expressly excludes it from being counted as an unanswered witness, and no other verse is counted that way."}
